name: codeaudit
description: White-box source code security audit framework - static source-to-sink analysis across 17 vulnerability domains: core 10 (injection, XSS, auth, access control, SSRF, secrets, crypto, dependencies, configuration, logging) plus extended 7 (business logic, feature abuse, data lifecycle/isolation, client-side, HTTP protocol, AI/LLM, resource exhaustion) with optional live correlation
